title: Toe last shoe on machine
setting: Footwear factory, standing at a toe-lasting machine
masks_caveat: from about 7.2 s another worker's hand appears at the top of the image; it is not outlined, and neither is the wearer's right hand there.
contact_roles: both hands hold the shoe sole-up in the machine through the press, then put it on the conveyor beside its pair. Parts of this clip's contact were corrected by a reviewer watching the video, where the automatic cues missed it (contact.parquet marks those frames labelled_by = review).
